cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(lightscaper_desktop_windows_job_canary_current_v1 LANGUAGES CXX)
if(NOT WIN32 OR NOT MSVC)
	message(FATAL_ERROR "The Lightscaper Job Object canary requires native Windows MSVC")
endif()
if(LIGHTSCAPER_SMOKE_NATIVE_TARGET STREQUAL "win-x64")
	if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(AMD64|x86_64|x64)$" OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
		message(FATAL_ERROR "The Lightscaper canary is not targeting native Windows x64")
	endif()
elseif(LIGHTSCAPER_SMOKE_NATIVE_TARGET STREQUAL "win-arm64")
	if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(ARM64|aarch64|arm64)$" OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
		message(FATAL_ERROR "The Lightscaper canary is not targeting native Windows ARM64")
	endif()
else()
	message(FATAL_ERROR "An explicit win-x64 or win-arm64 LIGHTSCAPER_SMOKE_NATIVE_TARGET is required")
endif()
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
add_executable(lightscaper-windows-job-reader-fixture-current-v1 reader-fixture.cpp)
add_executable(lightscaper-windows-job-canary-current-v1 job-canary.cpp)
foreach(target lightscaper-windows-job-reader-fixture-current-v1 lightscaper-windows-job-canary-current-v1)
	target_compile_features(${target} PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
	set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
	target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN NOMINMAX _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00)
	target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE /W4 /WX /permissive- /utf-8)
	target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE kernel32)
endforeach()
